style: Ability icons from a 1998 Nintendo 64 fantasy game, in the style of Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time item icons and Banjo-Kazooie menu art. All icons share one consistent palette and painting style.
itemStyle: Each icon: chunky, bold, instantly readable silhouette, hand-painted with a few flat saturated colours and simple shading, warm top-left light, thick dark outline, filling most of its cell.
suffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders, no grid lines, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Plain flat pure magenta background (#FF00FF) everywhere.

fire: a roaring fireball with a bright yellow core
a round iron shield glowing with embers
a glowing lava crack splitting a boulder
a small phoenix feather trailing flames
